subject: Request: Temporary surge hotseat coverage exception for P1/P2 response (seeding week)
messages:
From: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Linda Torres <linda.torres@pulsarpayments.com>
Cc: support@pulsarpayments.com
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Request: Temporary surge hotseat coverage exception for P1/P2 response (seeding week)

Hi team,

Pulsar is going live with their billing seeding next Friday (12/11) and they expect a short but high-volume window for the first 72 hours. They asked us to provide an elevated on-call posture to guarantee P1/P2 response times while they run through initial ingestion.

Ask: can we approve a temporary hotseat coverage exception for the seeding week (12/11 00:00 PST - 12/14 23:59 PST) that does the following:
- Assign a dedicated hotseat engineer (single point on-call for surge) for 12-hour blocks covering the 72-hour window
- Shorten P1 ack to 15 minutes and P2 ack to 45 minutes for that period
- Use the attached roster and escalation matrix as the operational plan

I realize this is an SLA carveout. Rationale: Pulsar is in our top-5 strategic early customers; failure during seeding would be costly. They're willing to accept an exception if we provide a clear escalation path and a named hotseat. Marissa/Karthik, can you review operational feasibility and confirm rotation + cost/credits?

Linda, looping you so Pulsar sees the proposed plan upfront. If you have internal on-call contacts we should tie into the escalation matrix, please add them.

Attachments: hotseat_roster_v2.csv, proposed_escalation_matrix.pdf

Thanks,
Alex Martinez
Sr. Manager, Customer Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Linda Torres <linda.torres@pulsarpayments.com>
Date: Mon, 07 Dec 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary surge hotseat coverage exception for P1/P2 response (seeding week)

Alex — thanks for the heads up.

High level: I support a temporary hotseat but need a few operational guarantees before I can sign off formally:
- Confirmed named hotseat(s) (we should limit to 2 x 12-hr rotating backups to avoid fatigue)
- A clear escalation ladder (internal L2 -> L3 -> Eng on-call -> exec bridge) with paging windows
- Agreement on customer-facing credits if we miss the short window SLAs (so we don't create asymmetric expectations)

Karthik, can you bake those into the attached escalation matrix and confirm that the 15/45 windows are achievable given current paging flows? Also, flag any telemetry gaps that would prevent us from measuring ack times.

Linda — from a contract perspective, we'll need Pulsar to acknowledge the exception and the credit terms. A short email confirming acceptance (with contact numbers) is sufficient; we'll follow with an internal change request.

I'll tentatively approve once Karthik confirms the runway and we have a signed acceptance from Pulsar.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Head of Support Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Linda Torres <linda.torres@pulsarpayments.com>
Date: Tue, 08 Dec 2026 08:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary surge hotseat coverage exception for P1/P2 response (seeding week)

Marissa / Alex — reviewed the plan and updated the attachments. Summary of changes in proposed_escalation_matrix.pdf and hotseat_roster_v2.csv:
- Named hotseat engineers: Priya N. and Sean G. (12-hr blocks, Priya covers 00:00–12:00 PST, Sean covers 12:00–24:00 PST; each has one standby backup for overflow)
- Escalation ladder: hotseat -> L2 support -> L3 platform on-call -> Eng on-call -> Bridge ops execs. Added phone escalation numbers and an explicit 10-minute page retry cadence for P1s.
- Telemetry: added a lightweight ack-tracker (we'll instrument a tag on Pulsar's route to measure first-ack times; initial probing shows we can report 15/45 windows with 90% confidence). Full accuracy requires the new tag deployment by EOD 12/10.
- Credits: proposed 5% service credit applied to the affected invoice if we miss P1 ack more than once in the 72-hour window.

Notes / risks:
- Overnight (PST 00:00–06:00) staffing will be thin; hotseat model mitigates this but fatigue risk exists if we get multiple P1s in a short span. Recommend 4-hr overlap between shifts on 12/12 to ease handoffs during expected traffic peak.
- If the telemetry tag isn't in place by 12/10, we should postpone the formal exception and use a human-verified ack log.

Attaching: hotseat_roster_v2.csv, proposed_escalation_matrix.pdf

If Marissa confirms, I'll raise the change request and update JIRA SUP-1987.

Thanks,
Karthik Iyer
Senior Technical Program Manager, Support Reliability
Redwood Inference
From: Linda Torres <linda.torres@pulsarpayments.com>
To: Alex Martinez <alex_martinez@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 09 Dec 2026 14:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Request: Temporary surge hotseat coverage exception for P1/P2 response (seeding week)

Thanks, Alex / Marissa / Karthik — appreciate the fast responses and the concrete plan. Pulsar accepts the temporary hotseat coverage exception and the proposed 5% service credit if the P1 ack threshold is missed more than once.

Action items from our side:
- I will provide two Pulsar escalation contacts and phone numbers by EOD 12/09 and will confirm internal on-call overlap during the peak window.
- We accept the instrumentation approach; will coordinate with our SREs to whitelist the telemetry tag tomorrow.

Please proceed with the change request. Once we have the signed exception email logged, we consider this approved and will treat Redwood as primary on-call for the stated 72-hour window.

Best regards,
Linda Torres
Head of Platform Operations
Pulsar Payments, Inc.
